Effective Date: August 12, 2026

Quick Summary

Conduit is building experimental brain-computer interface and AI technologies. These Terms explain the rules for using our Site, learning about Conduit, applying for research opportunities, completing screening or booking flows, and communicating with us online.

Some parts of these Terms are especially important: Conduit does not provide medical care through the Site, research opportunities may change or be canceled, information you share may be used for research and product development as described below, and disputes are generally handled through individual arbitration rather than class actions.

These Terms of Use (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of the websites, pages, forms, booking flows, screening flows, content, communications, and online services operated by Conduit Intelligence PBC (“Conduit,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), including condu.it and any related webpages, third-party booking pages, forms, or communications that link to or reference these Terms (collectively, the “Site”).

By accessing or using the Site, submitting information through the Site, booking a research session, clicking to accept or acknowledge these Terms, or otherwise interacting with Conduit online, you agree to these Terms. These Terms include important limitations on Conduit’s liability, your obligation to indemnify Conduit, and a binding arbitration agreement and class action waiver. If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use the Site.

1. About Conduit

Conduit develops brain-computer interface, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and human-computer interaction technologies, including investigational brain-to-text and related technologies. The Site may describe Conduit’s technology, research, products, services, recruiting efforts, research participant opportunities, and related activities.

We provide information on the Site for general informational, recruitment, research, product development, business, and communication purposes.

2. Other Terms That May Apply

Additional terms may apply to particular activities, including participant consent forms, data authorizations, research protocols, study rules, site or facility rules, booking terms, payment terms, privacy notices, employment application terms, vendor agreements, nondisclosure agreements, product terms, or other written agreements.

If you participate in a Conduit study, pilot, test, evaluation, interview, research session, or data collection activity, your participation may be governed by a separate consent form, data authorization, research protocol, or written instructions. If there is a conflict between these Terms and a signed consent form or other written agreement with Conduit, the signed consent form or written agreement will control for the specific activity it covers, and these Terms will continue to apply to all other matters.

Conduit’s Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information. By using the Site, you acknowledge our Privacy Policy.

3. Conduit Does Not Provide Medical Care

The Site does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, emergency services, clinical decision support, health care services, or a substitute for professional medical judgment.

Conduit is not acting as your health care provider through the Site, through any research participant booking flow, or by making any technology, study, or research opportunity available. You should not rely on the Site, Conduit technology descriptions, study materials, research outputs, model outputs, or any Conduit communications for medical, mental health, diagnostic, treatment, monitoring, prevention, or emergency purposes.

If you have a medical emergency, call emergency services.

Conduit’s technologies and research activities may be experimental, developmental, and subject to change. Unless Conduit expressly says otherwise in a signed written agreement, Conduit technologies are not approved, cleared, or authorized for any medical, diagnostic, therapeutic, assistive, safety-critical, or emergency use.

4. Research Sessions and Participant Opportunities

The Site may allow individuals to learn about, apply for, screen for, schedule, reschedule, cancel, or book paid or unpaid research sessions, interviews, pilots, evaluations, or data collection activities.

Submitting a form, requesting a booking, receiving a booking confirmation, passing any preliminary screening, or communicating with Conduit does not guarantee that you will be accepted, permitted to participate, complete a session, receive any particular payment, receive any result or benefit, or be eligible for future sessions.

Conduit may accept, decline, reschedule, cancel, pause, end, remove you from, or stop any booking or participation opportunity at any time for any reason, including eligibility, safety, identity verification, scheduling, technical, capacity, study-integrity, data-quality, confidentiality, facility-access, premises, misconduct, or business reasons.

If you attend an in-person session, you must follow Conduit’s instructions, facility rules, safety rules, confidentiality requirements, and reasonable directions from Conduit personnel. You may not enter restricted areas, remain on the premises outside your scheduled session time, disrupt building operations, disturb other occupants, bring unauthorized guests, record or photograph the premises or session, or engage in conduct that Conduit considers unsafe, disruptive, unlawful, or inconsistent with study integrity.

5. Your Status as a Participant

If you participate in a Conduit research session or data collection activity, you are participating as a voluntary research participant for limited research, testing, evaluation, or data collection purposes unless Conduit separately agrees otherwise in writing.

You are not an employee, intern, contractor, consultant, agent, representative, service provider, worker, trainee, or joint venturer of Conduit by using the Site, submitting information, booking a session, or participating in a research session. Any participant payment is an honorarium or participation payment for time, inconvenience, and study participation, not wages, salary, benefits, expense reimbursement, or compensation for services.

You may not bind Conduit, act on Conduit’s behalf, or represent that you work for Conduit.

6. Eligibility

You may use the Site only if you can form a legally binding agreement with Conduit, are legally permitted to use the Site, and are not barred from using the Site under applicable law or any prior restriction imposed by Conduit.

Research participation is intended for individuals who are at least 18 years old unless Conduit provides a separate written process for minors with required parental or guardian consent.

By using the Site or submitting information, you represent that the information you provide is accurate, complete, current, and not misleading, and that you will promptly update information if it changes or becomes inaccurate.

7. Bookings, Cancellations, and Payments

Research session availability, location, duration, payment amounts, payment method, eligibility criteria, screening requirements, limits on repeat participation, arrival windows, cancellation rules, and other session details may be described on the Site, in booking materials, payment materials, or participant consent materials.

Conduit may change availability, payment amounts, payment methods, eligibility criteria, screening requirements, scheduling rules, cancellation rules, and booking procedures at any time, subject to any signed consent form or other written agreement that expressly states otherwise.

Payment, if any, is subject to completion of applicable study requirements to Conduit’s satisfaction, identity verification, compliance with study instructions, applicable consent terms, tax or payment onboarding, and Conduit’s payment procedures. Conduit may withhold, reduce, delay, or reverse payment in cases of fraud, identity-verification failure, duplicate participation, ineligibility, late arrival, early departure, no-show, misconduct, safety issues, material violation of instructions, or conduct that compromises confidentiality, data integrity, study integrity, facility access, or building operations.

You are responsible for any taxes, reporting obligations, payment-account requirements, payment-provider fees, and payment-provider terms that may apply to amounts you receive.

You represent that you have all rights, consents, and permissions necessary to provide your User Submissions and that your User Submissions are accurate, lawful, not misleading, not confidential to any third party unless you are authorized to share them, and do not violate the rights of any person.

This includes maintaining research records, supporting legal and compliance needs, protecting safety and study integrity, improving Conduit technologies, and preserving evidence of consent, authorization, eligibility, communications, and participation.

Do not submit information that you do not want Conduit to receive, process, retain, disclose, or use as described in these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
